entries.speaker: Ms. Kawakami

entries.en: There's been an unusual number of[n]strange incidents this year. Don't do[n]anything stupid over break.

entries.en: Well, no matter what the cause was,[n]this election is heading in the right[n]direction.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Before we knew it, Shido had everyone[n]in the palm of his hand.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Deceiving people so well that they[n]don't even realize it... Just how[n]influential is Shido?

entries.speaker: Ms. Kawakami
entries.en: Okay, listen up!

entries.speaker: Ms. Kawakami
entries.en: The police are here at the school,[n]so be sure not to get in their way.

entries.speaker: Ms. Kawakami
entries.en: Oh, and...

entries.speaker: Ms. Kawakami
entries.en: For various reasons, the school[n]festival got moved to the 25th.

entries.speaker: Ms. Kawakami
entries.en: There was talk of canceling it,[n]but we couldn't just do that.

entries.speaker: Ms. Kawakami
entries.en: I'm sure the preparations will be rough,[n]but don't push yourself too hard.

entries.en: Oh yeah, I just remembered something[n]I learned about psychology.
